system.name: QRWTY
system.description: Public short links and QR codes. Guests create links without signing in; accounts own, edit and analyse theirs; individual free and paid plans. A redirect is sent only after its click is durably acknowledged.

services.name: Account API
services.description: Signed-in reads: the caller's own links and their analytics. Reads the Links owner view and Analytics, checks entitlements with Billing API, and forwards no writes.

components.name: Link analytics
components.purpose: Owner-only counts, ranges, freshness and bounded CSV export. Checks ownership in the Links owner view and the tier's lookback and export allowance with Billing API.

components.name: My links
components.purpose: Cursor pages (at most 50, by created_at and id) of the caller's own links from the Links owner view.

requires.reason: Data access needs a database connection.

components.name: Sign-in
components.purpose: Required: every route needs a valid token. Each query is scoped to the verified subject, cursors included.

services.name: Analytics worker
services.description: Validates, deduplicates and aggregates click events, expires bounded data and acknowledges only after its transaction commits. Sole writer of Analytics.

components.name: Click aggregator
components.purpose: Validates and deduplicates each click event within a bounded horizon, updates aggregates and acknowledges after commit. Poison events go to quarantine, never dropped.

services.name: Billing API
services.description: Hosted Checkout and portal, a signature-verified Stripe webhook inbox, subscription reconciliation and entitlement grants. Sole writer of Billing.

components.name: Customer billing
components.purpose: Signed-in owner only: plan status, hosted Checkout and portal sessions from allowlisted prices, allowed return URLs and idempotency keys. CSRF is checked by Session API.

components.name: Entitlements
components.purpose: Entitlement grants valid for at most 60 seconds, for Link API and Account API only. Fails closed for paid-gated operations when no valid grant exists.

components.name: Payment events
components.purpose: No session: verifies the Stripe signature over the raw body bytes, stores the event in the inbox before 2xx, then reconciles subscriptions from Stripe under a lease.

components.name: Sign-in
components.purpose: Optional, so Stripe reaches the webhook without a token. Customer routes still require a signed-in owner; the webhook is authorized by its Stripe signature instead.

services.name: Identity
services.description: Verified account identity over OIDC. Local Keycloak while testing; the managed issuer is a deployment compatibility decision.

services.name: Link API
services.description: Guest create, claim with one-time proof, owned edits and deletes, abuse reports and operator decisions. Sole writer of Links; asks Billing API for entitlement grants on owned operations.

components.name: Abuse and moderation
components.purpose: Bounded public abuse reports (202, no disposition shown) and block or unblock under a separate operator permission. A report alone never disables a link.

components.name: Link operations
components.purpose: Create (guest or owned) with CSPRNG slugs, idempotency keys and admission; claim with one-time proof; If-Match edits; tombstone deletes. Reputation check and entitlement grant first.

components.name: Sign-in
components.purpose: Optional: guest create sends no token and is anonymous; an invalid or expired token is 401. Owner, claim and operator routes still check the verified subject.

services.name: Redirect service
services.description: Resolves host and slug, checks state and expiry, awaits the durable click acknowledgment, then answers 302. No sign-in or payment dependency.

components.name: Resolve and redirect
components.purpose: Host + slug via Hot routes, else the Links public view; state and expiry; publish the click and await its ACK; recheck; then 302 with no-store. Otherwise 404/410/403, or 503 with no Location.

services.name: Session API
services.description: Same-origin browser facade: OIDC code + PKCE sign-in, cookie sessions and CSRF. Forwards a valid bearer token (none on guest create) to the Link, Account and Billing APIs; never invents an identity header.

components.name: API forwarding
components.purpose: Checks the session cookie and CSRF on mutations, then forwards the bearer token (none on guest create) to Link, Account and Billing APIs. Refreshes tokens with Identity.

components.name: Sign-in flow
components.purpose: OIDC authorization code with PKCE, state and nonce; creates, refreshes and revokes cookie sessions (Secure, HttpOnly). Keeps the guest claim proof flow in the same tab.

resources.name: Admission cache
resources.description: Approximate distributed abuse and admission counters (Valkey). Durable hard account limits stay in Links transactions.

resources.name: Analytics
resources.description: Click aggregates plus bounded deduplication data. A separate PostgreSQL logical database, read by Account API.

resources.name: Billing
resources.description: Customer mappings, webhook inbox, subscription and entitlement revisions, reconciliation jobs and action idempotency. Restricted PostgreSQL logical database; no card data.

resources.name: Click events
resources.description: Click events, durably acknowledged before each redirect. Production transport is GCP Pub/Sub, pending G12; the local export uses the installed broker. The archive subscription is deployment.

resources.name: Hot routes
resources.description: Short-lived route metadata with a bounded freshness deadline (Valkey). Replaceable, never the source of truth.

resources.name: Links
resources.description: Durable routes, ownership, claim and idempotency data and tombstones. PostgreSQL; the public route view and the account owner view have separate grants.

resources.name: Sessions
resources.description: Encrypted tokens, session expiry and revocation state. A separate restricted PostgreSQL logical database, written only by Session API and never queried by the Redirect service.

externals.name: Reputation API
externals.description: Destination reputation check before a link is created. Unavailable means a retryable 503 on create; existing redirects continue.

externals.name: Stripe API
externals.description: Hosted payments and subscriptions (test mode). Its signed webhook reaches Billing API through the Create, manage & pay entry, not a line out of this tile.

connections.action: Publishes clicks and awaits the ACK
Reads routes, fills on a miss
Reads public routes on a cache miss
